title: Add deletion test and seam rules to architecture.md, independent-oracle rule to tests.md
action: Two additive edits, each in the target file's existing voice (trigger, move, concrete example) with routing-table rows added. (A) .bee/expertise/architecture.md, per CONTEXT.md D4, adapted from /home/thanhsmind/projects/AI/mattpocock-skill/skills/engineering/codebase-design/SKILL.md and DEEPENING.md (read both; rewrite, never copy): (1) the deletion test — judge a suspect module by imagining its deletion: complexity reappearing at N call sites means it earned its keep, complexity simply vanishing means it was a pass-through; (2) the adapter-count seam rule — one adapter over a dependency is a hypothetical seam, two is a real one; do not introduce ports/indirection until something actually varies; (3) four-way dependency taxonomy driving test strategy: in-process (no adapter, test directly), local-substitutable (test against the stand-in), remote-but-owned (in-memory adapter for tests, real transport in prod), true external (mock the injected port only); (4) replace-don't-layer — after deepening a module behind an interface, delete the old shallow unit tests once interface-level tests cover the behavior; a test that breaks on an internal refactor was testing past the interface. (B) .bee/expertise/tests.md, per D6, adapted from /home/thanhsmind/projects/AI/mattpocock-skill/skills/engineering/tdd/tests.md: the independent-oracle rule — an expected value must come from a source the implementation cannot influence (a known literal, a hand-worked example, the spec), never recomputed the way the code computes it; a test whose assertion mirrors the implementation's own arithmetic passes by construction and verifies nothing; name the tautological test as the anti-pattern with one short good/bad pair consistent with the file's existing Rust examples. Skip anything either file already states (check both first).
goal: Architecture craft gains module-depth judgment tools; test craft closes the tautology hole.
verify: commands.test green (PATH cargo test --release); both sections in file voice; no duplication.

trace.outcome: Added deletion-test, adapter-count seam rule, dependency taxonomy, and replace-don't-layer to architecture.md; independent-oracle rule to tests.md
